title: A clearer setup screen
changes: /setup now lists every feature, including Blacklist, Sticky Messages, Reaction Roles and Civilian Jobs - these existed but never appeared there, so most servers never knew they were available
/setup now separates features that are ready from features that are switched on but unfinished, and tells you exactly what each one is still missing
/setup no longer refuses to help until you add yourself as a staff member - administrators already had access
Features are grouped in the setup menu now instead of listed in an arbitrary order, and Premium features are labelled as such
